scope: Engineering public pre-action context only; no inference, new benchmark, training or goal IR integration
intervention: Opt-in version1 forwards existing public receipts to a verifier; no added tools or automatic retry
acceptance: Original native ReAct receives only query,user_location,current_time
Verifier receives only receipts completed before proposed mutation dispatch
Workflow context covers observed devices and explicitly marks missing devices
Device and catalog facts have observation ordinal,turn and response SHA
Initial time is not claimed as current; state freshness and future state remain unknown
Hidden evaluator fields rejected recursively; oversized rows dropped whole with exact counts
Version0 unchanged; version1 report-only DENY does not cancel,repair or alter tool budget
Existing server environment full checks pass; native engineering case and local archive verified
stop_rule: Engineering failure stops any online semantic ablation; do not infer user Task completion or verifier calibration from tests
